passenger_service_started.note: Inaugurated virtually on 3 Nov 2026; commercial passenger services began 06:00 on 4 Nov 2026 (inauguration coverage; consortium partner Siemens press release, 3 Nov 2026). The operator's own timetable PDF publishes a working Maan to District Court service (first train 06:00 from Maan, District Court and other stations), so the line is in passenger service; the start date itself does not appear on the operator pages checked.

Shree Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex, Mahalunge

station_status.note: 17 of 23 stations opened with the launch on 2026-11-04: ten with both escalators, and seven initially with one staircase (Maan, Maan - MIDC Circle Phase II, Maan Bus Depot, Hinjawadi Phase II - Circle I, Padmabhushan Chowk, Agriculture College, District Court), per inauguration coverage. The six closed are targeted in phases: Balewadi High Street and Balewadi Phata by end Nov 2026, and Baner Gaon, Baner Pashan Link Road, Bhosalenagar - RBI and Shivaji Nagar by Jan 2027 (PMRDA schedule as reported in the press). The operator publishes no per-station open/closed list; its fare chart covers all 23 stations including closed ones, and its timetable runs Maan to District Court. Re-verify every status against punerimetro.in.

lines.boarding_rule: A station is selectable for boarding or alighting only when the data lists it as open. Line 3 open stations are media-reported (status_source: media, verified: false): the planner routes them and labels them as media-reported, never as operator-confirmed. Stations listed closed stay blocked ('not open yet') unless the operator confirms them open.

interchange.within_mahametro: Purple and Aqua share the District Court station and one fare system; one ticket covers the change.
interchange.line3_connection: Line 3 terminates at District Court, Pune and connects with Lines 1 & 2 there (operator route map and inauguration coverage agree). Line 3 is separately ticketed - see unverified_items for cross-system ticketing details.
operator_statements: Line 3 overview page: 'Pune Metro Line 3 has interchanges with Pune Metro Line 1 & 2' (https://punerimetro.in/about/overview).
Line 3 route map page: '02 Interchange Connections', stations not named (https://punerimetro.in/project-profile/route-map).

maha_metro.note: Full station-to-station matrix below, transcribed from the operator fare chart image and verified cell-by-cell. Station order matches lines.station_order for purple then aqua (District Court appears once per line; it is the same physical station - see station_aliases: CVC and CVC_AQ are the same station). Matrix indexes use station codes. Direction-asymmetric printed values are preserved as printed and listed under disputed_fare_pairs: they are disputed, not usable fares, and must fall back to 'check the official fare chart' until each direction is confirmed.

disputed_fare_pairs.note: The operator chart prints these direction-asymmetric fares (likely typos in the official chart). printed_from_to and printed_to_from are exactly as printed; the raw matrix above preserves both directions unchanged. Treat each listed pair as disputed in BOTH directions: do NOT show either printed value as the exact commuter fare until that direction is confirmed against the operator's own fare calculator or a second official source. Use the standard 'check the official fare chart' fallback for these pairs. Never average and never silently symmetrize.

corrections.detail: The brief listed Kasarwadi->Bund Garden as 25 (printed) and Bund Garden->Kasarwadi as 30, making the pair direction-asymmetric. Re-reading the operator's fare chart image (enlarged crop and an independent per-cell classification) shows 30 in both directions, so the pair is symmetric and is no longer disputed.

line3.note: Full station-to-station matrix from the operator fare chart image, extracted cell-by-cell from the chart grid and verified symmetric. Index order = pink_line3 station_order. Chart includes all 23 stations including currently closed ones. Same-station cells print 12 (minimum/entry fare as printed), not 0.

whatsapp_shared_number.note: Send 'Hi' to the official Pune Metro WhatsApp number and choose 'Line 3' in the bot (the options are Lines 1 and 2, and Line 3), pick origin and destination, pay by UPI or card; the QR e-ticket arrives on WhatsApp. The number is the official Pune Metro e-ticket number published on the Maha Metro homepage (verified there). The Line 3 option on it is from launch-day media reports (one describing a trial booking); the Line 3 operator's amenities page confirms WhatsApp QR ticketing but publishes no number.

line3.whatsapp_note: Operator's fare-table page confirms WhatsApp QR ticketing but publishes no Line 3-specific number on the pages checked. Launch-day media reports say the shared official number wa.me/9420101990 offers a 'Line 3' option (see whatsapp_shared_number); not confirmed on the operator's own pages. Do not probe the bot with test messages.
